Sir paper leaked again lol. Give me the Rs.10000 you bet hehehe.

Bro, I think you should say something at this point.

implementationRules: Render this copy verbatim. Do not silently correct grammar, spelling, capitalization or punctuation.
The missing IDs phone_09 and phone_11 are intentionally retired and must not be regenerated.
Notifications draw attention but never require a click and never pause complaint shredding.
Wrap long messages to a maximum of three short lines on the phone screen.
Use the shared restrained phone buzz except where sound is explicitly null.
Treat phone playback as game-owned audio for microphone echo protection.
